name: Kisan Credit Card Scheme for Fisheries- Chief Minister Fishermen Prosperity Scheme
benefit: - Short-term working capital loans for fisheries activities under the Kisan Credit Card (KCC) facility. - Fish farmers receive interest subvention, enabling access to zero-percent interest loans through cooperative banks. - The loan amount is determined as per bank norms and scheme provisions, based on the financial requirement of the fish farmer.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a landholding farmer, marginal farmer, small farmer, fish farmer, livestock owner, BPL beneficiary, unorganized worker card holder, or registered worker. 1. The applicant must be engaged in fisheries activities.
